verses.original: זְב֣וּבֵי מָ֔וֶת יַבְאִ֥ישׁ יַבִּ֖יעַ שֶׁ֣מֶן רוֹקֵ֑חַ יָקָ֛ר מֵחָכְמָ֥ה מִכָּב֖וֹד סִכְל֥וּת מְעָֽט׃
verses.transliteration: zə·ḇū·ḇê mā·weṯ yaḇ·’îš yab·bî·a‘ še·men rō·w·qê·aḥ yā·qār mê·ḥā·ḵə·māh mik·kā·ḇō·wḏ siḵ·lūṯ mə·‘āṭ
verses.literal: As dead flies bring a stench to the perfumer’s oil so a little folly outweighs wisdom and honor

verses.original: לֵ֤ב חָכָם֙ לִֽימִינ֔וֹ וְלֵ֥ב כְּסִ֖יל לִשְׂמֹאלֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: lêḇ ḥā·ḵām lî·mî·nōw wə·lêḇ kə·sîl liś·mō·lōw
verses.literal: A wise man’s heart inclines to the right but the heart of a fool to the left

verses.original: וְגַם־ בַּדֶּ֛רֶךְ כְּשֶׁהַסָּכָל הֹלֵ֖ךְ לִבּ֣וֹ חָסֵ֑ר וְאָמַ֥ר לַכֹּ֖ל סָכָ֥ל הֽוּא׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḡam- bad·de·reḵ kə·šɛ·has·så̄·ḵå̄l hō·lêḵ lib·bōw ḥā·sêr wə·’ā·mar lak·kōl sā·ḵāl hū
verses.literal: Even as the fool walks along the road his sense is lacking and he shows everyone that he is a fool

verses.original: אִם־ ר֤וּחַ הַמּוֹשֵׁל֙ תַּעֲלֶ֣ה עָלֶ֔יךָ מְקוֹמְךָ֖ אַל־ תַּנַּ֑ח כִּ֣י מַרְפֵּ֔א יַנִּ֖יחַ חֲטָאִ֥ים גְּדוֹלִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ’im- rū·aḥ ham·mō·wō·šêl ta·‘ă·leh ‘ā·le·ḵā mə·qō·wm·ḵā ’al- tan·naḥ kî mar·pê yan·nî·aḥ ḥă·ṭā·’îm gə·ḏō·w·lîm
verses.literal: If the ruler’s temper flares against you do not abandon your post for calmness lays great offenses to rest

verses.original: יֵ֣שׁ רָעָ֔ה רָאִ֖יתִי תַּ֣חַת הַשָּׁ֑מֶשׁ כִּשְׁגָגָ֕ה שֶׁיֹּצָ֖א מִלִּפְנֵ֥י הַשַּׁלִּֽיט׃
verses.transliteration: yêš rā·‘āh rā·’î·ṯî ta·ḥaṯ haš·šā·meš kiš·ḡā·ḡāh še·yō·ṣā mil·lip̄·nê haš·šal·lîṭ
verses.literal: There is an evil I have seen under the sun an error that proceeds from the ruler

verses.original: נִתַּ֣ן הַסֶּ֔כֶל בַּמְּרוֹמִ֖ים רַבִּ֑ים וַעֲשִׁירִ֖ים בַּשֵּׁ֥פֶל יֵשֵֽׁבוּ׃
verses.transliteration: nit·tan has·se·ḵel bam·mə·rō·w·mîm rab·bîm wa·‘ă·šî·rîm baš·šê·p̄el yê·šê·ḇū
verses.literal: Folly is appointed to great heights but the rich sit in lowly positions

verses.original: רָאִ֥יתִי עֲבָדִ֖ים עַל־ סוּסִ֑ים וְשָׂרִ֛ים הֹלְכִ֥ים כַּעֲבָדִ֖ים עַל־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: rā·’î·ṯî ‘ă·ḇā·ḏîm ‘al- sū·sîm wə·śā·rîm hō·lə·ḵîm ka·‘ă·ḇā·ḏîm ‘al- hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: I have seen slaves on horseback while princes go on foot like slaves

verses.original: חֹפֵ֥ר גּוּמָּ֖ץ בּ֣וֹ יִפּ֑וֹל וּפֹרֵ֥ץ גָּדֵ֖ר יִשְּׁכֶ֥נּוּ נָחָֽשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: ḥō·p̄êr gūm·māṣ bōw yip·pō·wl ū·p̄ō·rêṣ gā·ḏêr yiš·šə·ḵen·nū nā·ḥāš
verses.literal: He who digs a pit may fall into it and he who breaches a wall may be bitten by a snake

verses.original: מַסִּ֣יעַ אֲבָנִ֔ים יֵעָצֵ֖ב בָּהֶ֑ם בּוֹקֵ֥עַ עֵצִ֖ים יִסָּ֥כֶן בָּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: mas·sî·a‘ ’ă·ḇā·nîm yê·‘ā·ṣêḇ bā·hem bō·w·qê·a‘ ‘ê·ṣîm yis·sā·ḵen bām
verses.literal: The one who quarries stones may be injured by them and he who splits logs endangers himself

verses.original: אִם־ קֵהָ֣ה הַבַּרְזֶ֗ל וְהוּא֙ לֹא־ פָנִ֣ים קִלְקַ֔ל וַחֲיָלִ֖ים יְגַבֵּ֑ר וְיִתְר֥וֹן הַכְשֵׁ֖יר חָכְמָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ’im- qê·hāh hab·bar·zel wə·hū lō- p̄ā·nîm qil·qal wa·ḥă·yā·lîm yə·ḡab·bêr wə·yiṯ·rō·wn haḵ·šēr ḥāḵ·māh
verses.literal: If the axe is dull and the blade unsharpened more strength must be exerted but skill produces success

verses.original: אִם־ יִשֹּׁ֥ךְ הַנָּחָ֖שׁ בְּלוֹא־ לָ֑חַשׁ וְאֵ֣ין יִתְר֔וֹן לְבַ֖עַל הַלָּשֽׁוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: ’im- yiš·šōḵ han·nā·ḥāš bə·lō·w- lā·ḥaš wə·’ên yiṯ·rō·wn lə·ḇa·‘al hal·lā·šō·wn
verses.literal: If the snake bites before it is charmed there is no profit for the charmer . . .

verses.original: דִּבְרֵ֥י פִי־ חָכָ֖ם חֵ֑ן וְשִׂפְת֥וֹת כְּסִ֖יל תְּבַלְּעֶֽנּוּ׃
verses.transliteration: diḇ·rê p̄î- ḥā·ḵām ḥên wə·śip̄·ṯō·wṯ kə·sîl tə·ḇal·lə·‘en·nū
verses.literal: The words of a wise man’s mouth are gracious but the lips of a fool consume him

verses.original: תְּחִלַּ֥ת דִּבְרֵי־ פִ֖יהוּ סִכְל֑וּת וְאַחֲרִ֣ית פִּ֔יהוּ הוֹלֵל֖וּת רָעָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: tə·ḥil·laṯ diḇ·rê- p̄î·hū siḵ·lūṯ wə·’a·ḥă·rîṯ pî·hū hō·w·lê·lūṯ rā·‘āh
verses.literal: The beginning of his talk . . . is folly and the end of his speech is evil madness

verses.original: וְהַסָּכָ֖ל יַרְבֶּ֣ה דְבָרִ֑ים לֹא־ יֵדַ֤ע הָאָדָם֙ מַה־ שֶׁיִּֽהְיֶ֔ה וַאֲשֶׁ֤ר יִֽהְיֶה֙ מֵֽאַחֲרָ֔יו מִ֖י יַגִּ֥יד לֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·has·sā·ḵāl yar·beh ḏə·ḇā·rîm lō- yê·ḏa‘ hā·’ā·ḏām mah- še·yih·yeh wa·’ă·šer yih·yeh mê·’a·ḥă·rāw mî yag·gîḏ lōw
verses.literal: Yet the fool multiplies words No one knows what is coming and who can tell him what will come after him

verses.original: עֲמַ֥ל הַכְּסִילִ֖ים תְּיַגְּעֶ֑נּוּ אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹֽא־ יָדַ֖ע לָלֶ֥כֶת אֶל־ עִֽיר׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ă·mal hak·kə·sî·lîm tə·yag·gə·‘en·nū ’ă·šer lō- yā·ḏa‘ lā·le·ḵeṯ ’el- ‘îr
verses.literal: The toil of a fool wearies him for he does not know the way to the city

verses.original: אִֽי־ לָ֣ךְ אֶ֔רֶץ שֶׁמַּלְכֵּ֖ךְ נָ֑עַר וְשָׂרַ֖יִךְ בַּבֹּ֥קֶר יֹאכֵֽלוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ’î- lāḵ ’e·reṣ šem·mal·kêḵ nā·‘ar wə·śā·ra·yiḵ bab·bō·qer yō·ḵê·lū
verses.literal: Woe to you O land whose king is a youth and whose princes feast in the morning

verses.original: אַשְׁרֵ֣יךְ אֶ֔רֶץ שֶׁמַּלְכֵּ֖ךְ בֶּן־ חוֹרִ֑ים וְשָׂרַ֙יִךְ֙ בָּעֵ֣ת יֹאכֵ֔לוּ בִּגְבוּרָ֖ה וְלֹ֥א בַשְּׁתִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ’aš·rêḵ ’e·reṣ šem·mal·kêḵ ben- ḥō·w·rîm wə·śā·ra·yiḵ bā·‘êṯ yō·ḵê·lū biḡ·ḇū·rāh wə·lō ḇaš·šə·ṯî
verses.literal: Blessed are you O land whose king is a son of nobles and whose princes feast at the proper time for strength and not for drunkenness

verses.original: בַּעֲצַלְתַּ֖יִם יִמַּ֣ךְ הַמְּקָרֶ֑ה וּבְשִׁפְל֥וּת יָדַ֖יִם יִדְלֹ֥ף הַבָּֽיִת׃
verses.transliteration: ba·‘ă·ṣal·ta·yim yim·maḵ ham·mə·qā·reh ū·ḇə·šip̄·lūṯ yā·ḏa·yim yiḏ·lōp̄ hab·bā·yiṯ
verses.literal: Through laziness the roof caves in and in the hands of the idle the house leaks

verses.original: לִשְׂחוֹק֙ עֹשִׂ֣ים לֶ֔חֶם וְיַ֖יִן יְשַׂמַּ֣ח חַיִּ֑ים וְהַכֶּ֖סֶף יַעֲנֶ֥ה אֶת־ הַכֹּֽל׃
verses.transliteration: liś·ḥō·wq ‘ō·śîm le·ḥem wə·ya·yin yə·śam·maḥ ḥay·yîm wə·hak·ke·sep̄ ya·‘ă·neh ’eṯ- hak·kōl
verses.literal: A feast is prepared for laughter and wine makes life merry but money is the answer for everything

verses.original: גַּ֣ם בְּמַדָּֽעֲךָ֗ מֶ֚לֶךְ אַל־ תְּקַלֵּ֔ל וּבְחַדְרֵי֙ מִשְׁכָּ֣בְךָ֔ אַל־ תְּקַלֵּ֖ל עָשִׁ֑יר כִּ֣י ע֤וֹף הַשָּׁמַ֙יִם֙ יוֹלִ֣יךְ אֶת־ הַקּ֔וֹל וּבַ֥עַל הַכְּנָפַיִם יַגֵּ֥יד דָּבָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: gam bə·mad·dā·‘ă·ḵā me·leḵ ’al- tə·qal·lêl ū·ḇə·ḥaḏ·rê miš·kā·ḇə·ḵā ’al- tə·qal·lêl ‘ā·šîr kî ‘ō·wp̄ haš·šā·ma·yim yō·w·lîḵ ’eṯ- haq·qō·wl ū·ḇa·‘al hak·kə·nå̄·p̄a·yim yag·gêḏ dā·ḇār
verses.literal: Do not curse the king even in your thoughts or curse the rich even in your bedroom . . . for a bird of the air may carry your words and a winged creature . . . may report your speech
